**Survivors judged (this seat's own equivalence judgement, J183).**

* **S9b — `mainRoadsStep` reading `boundaryCrossings` where it reads `crossingsThrough`.** Not equivalent in general: on
  an outline a standing way only grazes, c would count the graze and S5b spawn one primary fewer (N-9's shortfall,
  fail-safe: no throw, no wrong commit, the gates every meeting as before). Equivalent on every fixture and registered
  family: the frames probe reads 0 grazes on every stage boundary of 400 / 30 seeds 1 – 12, 900 / 90 1 – 6, 400 / 12
  1 – 5 and CITY 79, and the bar's `grazes` term (`recountC` meetings − crossings) is 0 on CITY 1 – 100 (every row's
  gate count equals max(N_k, c)). The row's promise — c counts crossings — is pinned at the function (S9a killed by
  boundary.test's tangent-way fixture, the inventory's fix shape); the one-line call site has no end-to-end graze
  fixture. A hardening test gap, not a blocker: N-34.
* **S14a (ARM2) and S14b — the seam's second-batch refusal and `traceStage`'s armed-batch count check off.** Backstops:
  no honest input opens a second batch through the seam (M0-c-02's trace commits in one callback batch, its strips in
  one), so nothing distinguishes the guards today — S14a-p is green on the whole non-bar set (33 / 33). The row's fix
  shape ("test one callback batch") is the sequence pin, present and green; the refusal text is unpinned. N-36.
* **S16b — `wetPointOn` without halving below the midpoint (the ends and the midpoint tested).** Not equivalent in
  general: an edge whose wet stretch avoids its midpoint (a corner crossed near one end) is passed. Equivalent on every
  fixture: guards.test's corner edge, 3 cm edge and island case and proof.test's puddle edge all hold the midpoint in
  the water (S16b-p green on the stop-withheld pins and the strips pins). The code's halving bound is right by reading
  (a distance is 1-Lipschitz; `d + half <= floorCm` prunes, `half < 0.25` stops). A hardening test gap in the proof's
  own fixture: N-35.
